Ballpark Nachos
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 11:57pm

Ingredients




1 jar Cheez Whiz pasteurized process cheese spr
1 bag tortilla chips
Jalapeno nacho slices, drained

Preparation

1 Microwave Cheez Whiz as directed on label. Layer 1/2 of the tortilla chips 1/2 of the Cheez Whiz. Top with jalapeno nacho slices. Repeat layers. 2 Yield: 4 to 6 servings.
